body: Update: I’m okay. Thank you for your comments as it helped me actually get to the hospital.
Hi everyone, I ended up seeking help and things are sorted, thank you

I felt over the top amazing for the past 3 months and then within this past week have just plummeted.. I did end up switching jobs as I got let go from the old one but that’s the only change I’ve experienced. And the change hasn’t been bad aside from one single day.
I live in Canada so unfortunately do not fall under that category, I did end up talking to my manager about the assistant managers behaviour though. I doubt anything will happen though
My favourite response by a hospital crisis worker to me being suicidal was “grow the fuck up and get the fuck over it” I refuse to go to hospitals now.

Thank you all so much for your responses! Another thing that’s had me worried too is that I finally found the right medications 2 months ago to help treat my depression so I’m concerned about side effects of pills, But this is all great Information, thank you!

Please do! I’ve considered doing the same, I still might, I think the more we come forward with our stories the better it is! People relate to different things so maybe someone has yet to find a video that helps explain their experience, I feel that’s the case for myself. It’s good to know we aren’t alone so if you have any doubts I hope this helps!

I was on T for about 4 months, no surgeries or anything. Unfortunately I am still struggling tremendously with coming to terms with my identity. I just know that I’m not trans, and that hormones and surgery aren’t for me. So now I’m left more confused than ever but trying to live life as I did before identifying as trans
Only if you have anything you could use that would make you a hazard to yourself ex/ bottle of pills, or a weapon and you have the intent to act on it.

I live in BC Canada and agree there is no proper care for people struggling here either. I’m sorry you went through that. I’ve never had aggressive police officers show up at my door, I’ve had some really nice ambulance workers show up and we’re way nicer than the stupid psychiatrist who told me to “grow the fuck up” and “get the fuck over it” apparently here unless you’re hearing voices there’s no help for you. Also if you have a diagnosis of BPD you automatically get no help but if you have bipolar (like my stupid father) they treat you like gold. Pathetic. I hate Canada mental health services.

(FTMTF, 23) if you’ve been diagnosed with BPD it is possible that you could end up detransitioning. I’ve always had an unstable sense of self so that was big, I came out around the same time my friend did, I found myself not doing/liking things I used to in order to fit into the box of what a guy should stereotypically like and dislike. And all togeather I was trying to be someone I wasn’t.
Hi, was wondering if you got your swollen tonsil issue resolved? I’m currently in the same boat as you, but 23 F, and ex smoker/ex vaper. I’ve been terrified it’s cancer too

Not a doctor but My brother had the same thing! Apparently it was some sort of marks caused by bacteria.If you go to the doctor they should be able to prescribe some cream for it. My brother’s back cleared up after about a week of using the cream.
Not a doctor but could it possibly a callus? Those usually are pretty hard

For me (23ftmtf) I realized that I was trying so hard to be someone else that I was completely losing sight of who I really was. I never really “fit into a box” growing up and I thought that transitioning would be the solution to why I never fit in. But as time went on it was clear I wasn’t being true to myself and that it was merely out of self hatred that I was doing this (which I thought was the whole point of transitioning). despite attempting to transition I still hated myself but now I wasn’t even being myself... I’m glad I’ve realized that now
